bounded_agent_route_gates.request_envelope: Request classification is bounded by typed envelope and policy-grammar projection refs; classifier-only matches are audit inputs, not authority.

bounded_agent_route_gates.public_projection: Projection-only authority-preserving export emits the owner-recomputed safe summary or governed refusal.
bounded_agent_route_gates.replay: NL continuity and replay manifest carry prompt/tool, model, tool-schema, search, G5, and rule-version refs for drift detection.

surface_audience_notes.PUBLIC: May see projection-only region-widening status, official-use limits, visible limitation refs, S12/S13/S14 status summaries, and safe artifact refs without raw upstream payloads.
surface_audience_notes.REVIEWER: May see region scorecard refs, conversion status matrix refs, S14 feed/manifest refs, replay refs, orchestration-continuity refs, and blocker refs.
surface_audience_notes.EXPERT: May inspect dependency snapshot, grounding matrix, mechanism reuse, marginal cost, semantic loss, route registry, conformance, and health metric refs.
surface_audience_notes.MACHINE: May consume persisted JSON/TOML artifacts for write-set completeness, manifest drift, replay continuity, S14 consumer gate status, and readiness validation.

region_widening_route_gates.current_g5_blocker: Current G5 unchanged blocker remains a visible blocker and must not be counted as grounded region breadth.

region_widening_route_gates.g4_promotion_join: Only governed promotion records with grounded contracts can promote a case into region breadth.

region_widening_route_gates.public_projection: Projection refs only; public-export-bundle route is not registered.
region_widening_route_gates.replay: Continuity and replay manifests carry upstream G5/G6 fingerprints and generated artifact paths for drift detection.

hardening_route_gates.candidate_output_boundary: LLM or readiness-manifest text cannot author grounded, useful, domain-ceiling, or closeout outcomes.

hardening_route_gates.g8_boundary: G8 may be consumed as audit evidence only; closeout and domain-ceiling authority remain forbidden without measured blocker-specific search health.
hardening_route_gates.public_projection: PUBLIC/REVIEWER projection is out of scope until a dedicated projection artifact is produced.
hardening_route_gates.replay: Generated artifacts carry rule versions, reducer input hashes, output hashes, and persisted artifact refs for replay validation.
